name: unmap
description: UNMAP offline viewer (experimental, for UN staff; served unlisted and noindex at /unmap/). OSM planet PMTiles + Smart Maps GEL terrain on the globe; areas saved to the device (OPFS) for offline use.

scripts.deploy: vite build && find dist/site -name .DS_Store -delete && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: node tests/t-sources.mjs && node tests/t-style.mjs && node tests/t-areas.mjs && node tests/t-places.mjs && node tests/t-versions.mjs
